product_summary: A Korean-first mobile fashion curation app that turns a daily style brief and closet memory into one decisive outfit before shopping.
audiences: 도시 출퇴근자와 주말 약속이 잦은 20-30대 모바일 쇼핑 사용자
새 상품을 계속 둘러보기보다 보유 옷과 오늘의 상황에 맞는 한 벌을 빠르게 정하고 싶은 사용자
소재, 색감, 실루엣 근거를 보고 구매 후보를 신중하게 고르는 사용자

application_concept.primary_job: 사용자가 오늘의 상황, 취향, 보유 옷 신호를 바탕으로 하나의 착장 보드를 확정하고 저장하거나 필요한 아이템만 구매 후보로 넘긴다.
application_concept.success_moment: 사용자가 오늘의 look board를 저장하고, 부족한 한 가지 아이템의 사이즈/가격/대체 후보를 확인한 상태.
differentiation: 첫 화면은 상품 피드가 아니라 오늘의 brief와 look board가 함께 보이는 착장 조립 표면이다.
추천 근거는 감성 문장이 아니라 소재, 실루엣, 날씨, 보유 옷과의 연결로 설명된다.
쇼핑은 별도 카탈로그가 아니라 look board의 특정 아이템에서 열리는 하단 시트로 제한된다.

layout_skeleton.composition: signal spine plus look board with contextual shop sheet
layout_skeleton.navigation_model: bottom tab with local brief controls

primary_regions.name: Daily brief bar
primary_regions.role: 날씨, 일정, 피하고 싶은 요소를 한 줄로 요약하고 빠르게 조정

primary_regions.name: Signal spine
primary_regions.role: 오늘의 취향 신호를 세로 리듬으로 보여 주며 현재 추천의 근거를 고정

primary_regions.name: Look board
primary_regions.role: 완성된 착장과 핵심 아이템의 레이어 관계를 시각적으로 제시

primary_regions.name: Why it works
primary_regions.role: 소재, 실루엣, 보유 옷 연결 근거를 짧게 설명

primary_regions.name: Contextual shop sheet
primary_regions.role: 선택 아이템의 사이즈, 가격, 대체 후보, 저장 액션을 착장 문맥 안에서 처리

first_screen_contract: 첫 viewport 안에 daily brief, signal spine, look board가 함께 보여야 함
상품 목록보다 완성된 착장과 추천 근거가 먼저 보여야 함
저장, 대체 후보, shop sheet 액션이 thumb zone에 있어야 함
이미지는 장식 배경이 아니라 실제 의류/소재/레이어 맥락을 보여야 함
avoid_layouts: marketing landing page before task surface

signature_moves: Taste signals sit as a vertical signal spine instead of a generic filter row.
The main look board shows one assembled outfit decision, not multiple product cards.
Commerce stays inside a contextual shop sheet attached to one missing garment.
Closet memory appears as a compatibility signal before price.
repetition_risks: same top chip rail plus large hero card
oversized editorial photo without decision controls

component_decision.rationale: Foldline should implement the mobile outfit-decision surface directly: brief, signal spine, one look board, rationale, garment layers, and contextual shop sheet. Generic ecommerce grids, hero sections, dashboards, and raw baseline controls stay out of the actual component set.

core_components.name: app-shell
core_components.role: Constrains the phone-scale task surface and thumb-zone layering.
core_components.decision_reason: The app needs a bounded mobile shell, not a responsive desktop dashboard frame.

core_components.name: topbar
core_components.role: Shows place, weather, brand, and compact brief/profile actions.
core_components.decision_reason: The top area must carry today's context before any shopping action.

core_components.name: daily-brief
core_components.role: Summarizes occasion, avoid signal, and closet usage above the board.
core_components.decision_reason: This replaces generic filter chips with a task-specific daily styling brief.

core_components.name: signal-spine
core_components.role: Pins the active recommendation signals as a vertical selection rhythm.
core_components.decision_reason: Foldline needs a visible reasoning spine, not a horizontal category filter row.

core_components.name: signal-node
core_components.role: Represents one active or inactive styling signal.
core_components.decision_reason: Each signal must be inspectable and tappable without becoming a generic chip.

core_components.name: today-board
core_components.role: Pairs the signal spine and assembled look in the first viewport.
core_components.decision_reason: The primary screen grammar is a decision board, not a feed or catalog.

core_components.name: look-board
core_components.role: Shows the one selected outfit composition with garment imagery and caption.
core_components.decision_reason: The core object is one styled outfit decision, not multiple product cards.

core_components.name: board-confidence-mark
core_components.role: Shows confidence for the current outfit board.
core_components.decision_reason: The recommendation confidence belongs on the board itself, not as a dashboard metric.

core_components.name: look-board-pin
core_components.role: Targets a garment on the look board and opens its item context.
core_components.decision_reason: Item actions should start from the outfit image, not from a detached product grid.

core_components.name: reason-strip
core_components.role: Groups the short rationale notes tied to today's active signals.
core_components.decision_reason: Recommendation explanation is a first-class surface, not helper copy under a card.

core_components.name: reason-note
core_components.role: Explains material, silhouette, weather, or closet fit in one compact note.
core_components.decision_reason: This keeps fashion reasoning concrete and inspectable.

core_components.name: garment-stack
core_components.role: Lists the selected outfit layers as a small wardrobe stack.
core_components.decision_reason: Layers are the product object; they should not be flattened into commerce cards.

core_components.name: garment-row
core_components.role: Shows one owned or candidate garment with fit and context.
core_components.decision_reason: The row encodes ownership, fit, and weather context instead of pure price display.

core_components.name: fabric-swatch
core_components.role: Represents owned garment color or material when an image is unnecessary.
core_components.decision_reason: Closet memory needs tactile cues without fake product thumbnails.

core_components.name: closet-compatibility-mark
core_components.role: Signals whether a candidate works with already-owned pieces.
core_components.decision_reason: Compatibility appears before price so the app stays curation-led.

core_components.name: alternative-rail
core_components.role: Shows a small set of alternate styling lines for the same outfit intent.
core_components.decision_reason: Alternatives remain bounded to the current look instead of becoming an infinite feed.

core_components.name: alternative-item
core_components.role: Lets the user switch one alternative color or garment line.
core_components.decision_reason: This is a look refinement control, not a generic product tile.

core_components.name: shop-sheet
core_components.role: Handles size, price, save, and shopping actions for the selected garment.
core_components.decision_reason: Commerce must stay attached to one outfit item instead of taking over the home screen.

core_components.name: shop-sheet-item
core_components.role: Summarizes the currently selected garment inside the sheet.
core_components.decision_reason: The sheet needs garment memory and fit data before purchase actions.

core_components.name: size-chip-group
core_components.role: Allows compact size choice inside the contextual sheet.
core_components.decision_reason: Size is necessary transaction input but must remain scoped to the sheet.

core_components.name: save-look-action
core_components.role: Saves today's board or selected garment decision.
core_components.decision_reason: Saving the outfit is the success action, not a generic CTA.

core_components.name: bottom-tab-bar
core_components.role: Keeps board, closet, saved looks, and candidates reachable in the thumb zone.
core_components.decision_reason: Primary navigation belongs at the bottom for this one-handed mobile task.

core_components.name: saved-state-toast
core_components.role: Confirms that the current outfit board has been saved.
core_components.decision_reason: A small confirmation is enough; the success state should not become a modal.

rejected_components.name: product-grid
rejected_components.reason: Would turn the first screen into a shopping catalog instead of an outfit decision.

rejected_components.name: product-card
rejected_components.reason: Too generic for a closet-aware garment layer.

rejected_components.name: hero-cta-group
rejected_components.reason: The app opens on a task surface, not a marketing hero.

rejected_components.name: dashboard-card
rejected_components.reason: Fashion rationale should not look like operational metrics.

rejected_components.name: filter-chip
rejected_components.reason: Generic filters are replaced by signal-node decisions.

rejected_components.name: modal-dialog
rejected_components.reason: Item shopping belongs in a contextual bottom sheet.

rejected_components.name: command-palette
rejected_components.reason: The mobile fashion flow is visual and thumb-led, not keyboard-command-led.

notes: Use color reference as semantic evidence only.
Do not ship a fixed preset palette.
Prefer soft surfaces with one decisive ink/accent pair.
